headline: OAK @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.36 at SDP 4.81, with a projected total of 9.16. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (OAK +0.28, SDP +0.20), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.48, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: J.T. Ginn has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Andujar, Nick Kurtz, Carlos Cortes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Lawrence Butler, Jackson Merrill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
